class.name: SuperpositionProperty
class.brief_description: A typed, quantized gameplay property replication rule.
class.description: Created automatically from a [Superposition] target's Replicate checkbox. The server and client must use identical enabled property order, names, types and quantization. Only bool, int, float, String and Vector3 are supported; objects, resources and arbitrary containers cannot replicate.

members.member: Includes this property in the replication schema.
Existing property on the target node.
Exact Variant type, selected in the Inspector. Defaults to float.
Positive float/vector rounding interval. Zero preserves precision. Server change detection uses the quantized value.
Cosmetic exponential easing for float and Vector3. Discrete values always apply immediately.
